hero.title: Suresh Gyan Vihar University
hero.summary: Suresh Gyan Vihar University offers agricultural study in Jaipur from undergraduate to research level. Its School of Agriculture identifies hydroponics, protected cultivation and soil-testing facilities, with rural work and farmer interaction forming part of the school’s published learning approach.

overview.heading: Agriculture courses spanning crops, horticulture and engineering
paragraphs: SGVU was established through Rajasthan legislation in 2008. Its agriculture landing page lists B.Sc. Agriculture, agricultural engineering and master’s and doctoral subjects in agriculture and horticulture. The undergraduate agriculture degree is the programme explicitly printed in the checked ICAR row.

The school’s current facilities description includes soil science, plant pathology, entomology and biotechnology laboratories. Hydroponics and protected cultivation add a horticultural component to field-based crop study. The programme catalogue includes both agricultural science and engineering, while the master’s subject list extends from crop production and protection to horticultural specialisations.

admissions.heading: Planning an agriculture application
admissions.intro: The current school FAQ mentions PCM, PCB or Agriculture for undergraduate applicants and JET or ICAR channels. Because that page is undated, obtain the intake-specific subject, marks and counselling rules before choosing an examination route.

steps.title: Confirm the course
steps.text: Use the official programme contact to confirm that the listed degree is taking applications for your intended intake.

steps.title: Request the intake notice
steps.text: Ask for the applicable selection rules, fee breakdown and document checklist before submitting an application.

campus.heading: Hydroponics, soil analysis and village contact
campus.intro: SGVU’s school page identifies instructional farms and protected-cultivation units. A separate school account describes farmer-student and farmer-faculty interactions on campus and in an adopted village.

facilities.name: Hydroponics and protected cultivation
facilities.description: The school identifies working hydroponics and protected-cultivation facilities.

facilities.name: Soil science laboratory
facilities.description: The school describes soil-property and fertility-assessment practicals.

facilities.name: Enterprise and production units in the school brochure
facilities.description: The undated brochure lists mushroom production, seed processing, vermicompost, azolla, a greenhouse/nursery and a poly-pond/fisheries unit. Ask the school which units are available for the intended cohort.

practical_learning: The school’s farmer-interaction account describes work with farm families and extension tools.

The official school brochure describes summer/winter internships, field training and educational visits to ICAR research institutes, agricultural universities and KVKs. These are described learning activities, not guaranteed placement offers.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: An agriculture-specific scholarship and its current conditions have not yet been verified for this profile.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: The school states that it works with the university Training and Placement Office and provides competitive-examination guidance. Headline salary claims lack a sufficiently clear reporting year and cohort and are excluded.

recognition.text: ICAR lists School of Agriculture for 2022-10-11 to 2027-10-10. The exact degree labels appear below. Printed intake belongs to the accreditation record and does not establish current admission seat availability.

faqs.question: Which SGVU programme appears in the audited ICAR list?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. Hons Agriculture is explicitly printed for 11 October 2022 to 10 October 2027.

faqs.question: How long is the agriculture degree?
faqs.answer: The current school programme list gives four years for the B.Sc. and two years for agricultural master’s courses.

faqs.question: Does the school list horticulture postgraduate study?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fruit science, vegetable science, and floriculture and landscaping appear in its M.Sc. Horticulture list.

faqs.question: What farmer interaction is described?
faqs.answer: A school page describes on-campus and village-based interaction involving students, faculty and farm families.

faqs.question: Are current fee amounts verified here?
faqs.answer: No. A dated 2026-27 agriculture charge schedule was not verified in the checked sources.
